scripts.preflight: node -e "const net=require('net'); const ports=[5183,3000]; let busy=[]; const check=(i)=>{ if(i>=ports.length){ if(busy.length>0){console.error('BUSY PORTS:',busy.join(',')); process.exit(1);} else{console.log('All ports free'); process.exit(0);} return; } const s=net.createServer(); s.listen(ports[i],()=>{s.close(()=>check(i+1));}); s.on('error',()=>{busy.push(ports[i]); check(i+1);}); }; check(0);"
scripts.kill-ports: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');[5183,3000].forEach(p=>{try{const o=execSync('netstat -ano',{encoding:'utf8'});const m=o.match(new RegExp(':'+p+'\\s+.*LISTENING\\s+(\\d+)'));if(m){execSync('taskkill /F /PID '+m[1],{stdio:'ignore'});console.log('Killed PID '+m[1]+' on port '+p)}}catch{}})"
scripts.dev:all: npm run kill-ports && npm run dev
scripts.prod:canary:all: npm run kill-ports && npm run build --prefix frontend && concurrently "npm run prod:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
